scope: Stable five-finding shared-configuration review/fix node. Product review was read-only until individual fix authorization; parameter adapter fix owned by primary. No VisionEditor migration changes by this review.

findings.title: Hiding a subscribed row changed edit/subscribe mode
findings.reproduction: IsSub=true and a bound numeric row → CustomVisible=false → true. Before fix local IsSub became false although @ComName remained true.
checks: local IsSub and @user mode remain true with no user-store writes
showing again retains empty subscription editor

findings.title: No-op parameter apply was reported as committed and could execute with old backend value
findings.reproduction: Backend X=1, apply callback does nothing, CommitUser X=2. Before fix model=2/backend=1 and execution could be requested.
findings.boundary: Original successful native write does not itself force a GetParamUnit readback. Host Action persistence verification is an independent adapter transaction guarantee, not a claim that original native setter always rereads.
checks: backend failure keeps last accepted view value

findings.title: Panal tabs were treated as ordinary grouped parameter lists and offered subscriptions
findings.reproduction: TabType=1 with two Category.Items leaves. Before fix both ordinary rows rendered with scroll/group headers and SubscribeVisible=true. Actual shipped ColorSegment panel uses this branch.

checks: flattened first leaf, not first Category/CategoryNoHead
direct Grid/zero margin rather than scroll/group list
unsupported complex first leaf explicit without rendering extra fields
findings.screenshotAuthority: Independent source-derived isolated actual ColorSegment tab; unimplemented ColorSegmentList is explicitly shown. Not an original desktop capture.

findings.title: Failed clear could erase UI identity while host binding remained
findings.reproduction: A bound numeric row is hidden while ClearParameterBinding returns Error or throws IOException. Before fix local binding was cleared and parameter read even though host still bound.
checks: host and typed UI binding stay aligned
synchronous dispatcher failures become OperationError and Handled=false rather than WPF event exceptions

findings.title: Signed Int32 hexadecimal metadata was interpreted as unsigned or left unusable by numeric controls
findings.reproduction: Original Caliper PositionNegX0 has Cur/Default=0xffffff9c, Min=0xfffe7960, Max=0x186a0, Inc=0x1. Before fix Cur=4294967196 and raw hex range/step failed production double parsing.
checks: five CLR fields confirmed System.Int32 by original assembly reflection
12 original ParseInt cases include signed boundaries and overflow→0
five metadata fields compared with original results
production increment writes -99 rather than clamping to zero
findings.screenshotAuthority: Independent source-derived isolated original Caliper field at initial -100; not original desktop capture.

additionalReview.ComTailName: Verified source NameValueItem.ComName = Name + ComTailName. Current ParameterAdapter and user-domain keys preserve suffix; existing OperationChecks cover item0. No additional reproducible issue found.
additionalReview.defaultAccessMode: Source field defaults null; state now defaults absent transport access to empty, not RW. No additional shipped ordinary RW numeric fields missing MinValue/MaxValue found in the static installed XML scan.
additionalReview.closeExecution: Original ParamsConfigControlBase.Window_Closed stops self-execute and disposes/finishes model. Current ModelWindow disposes its session and migrated providers release their execution scheduler. No new source-confirmed close scheduling failure found in reviewed ordinary path; advanced native callbacks remain provider capability boundaries.

notClosedByThisNode: Full original desktop pixel/interaction parity; original BAML host rendering remains unavailable in earlier probe.
Complex panel factories such as ColorSegmentList remain explicitly unsupported; only common panel host behavior is implemented.
Global/local/workflow input/native private or CanSubscribe metadata/parent container/index services outside the bridge supported subset.
Original ISubChild composite expansion and legacy UTF8 read truncation branches remain previously documented limitations; no new implementation was added in this bounded review.
authority: Original decompiled managed source + original managed ParseInt/reflection runtime + independent regressions. Passing checks do not establish complete native parity.
